source: NHAI Instruction / FAQ Sheet - NSV Reports (D1-D4), last revised 6 Aug 2026
_how_to_read: Only what is described here is extracted into bronze. Anything else in a deliverable folder (file, sheet, GPKG layer) is NOT extracted and is reported as NOT_IN_SCHEMA.
required (default true): missing -> a problem. A required workbook missing -> the deliverable is not extracted.

headers / fields / csv_headers = the header gate: a sheet or layer missing one of them is REJECTED (not saved). Extra columns are saved and reported. Accepted spellings: exact, case/spaces, unit, aliases, same column position + same kind of values.
headers / fields / csv_headers are generated from a known-good delivery: python tools/build_schema.py "<template folder>" (aliases and everything else are kept).

Sheet options: sheet_names, kind (table | cells), skip, optional, header_row, header_rows, info_rows, skip_rows, columns (Excel range read as the table), cells (range also saved cell by cell), header_gate_columns (only these Excel columns are checked / generated).

upload_root._note: Files allowed directly in the uploaded report / UPC folder, next to the deliverable folders (D1..D4 or 'Deliverable N - ...'); file list only. Anything else there is NOT_IN_SCHEMA. Upload timestamps in front of file names ('1793260589326-') are removed before any matching.
